pages.title: Spring Waltz
pages.text: Lilac · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Lilac Tea Bag in a teapot with water; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)Spring has returned. The Earth is like a child that knows poems.$(br2)— Rainer Maria Rilke
